sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: So what's wrong with the export job?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: It runs out of memory on any account with more than ten thousand rows.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Ah, so only the big customers.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Right.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The export job crashes with out-of-memory errors on accounts above ten thousand rows.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Only the large ones, then.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yep, the small ones are fine.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Did you see the cloud bill?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: No, why?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: It jumped by {MONEY} last month, mostly from a test cluster someone forgot to shut down.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {MONEY}, okay.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Oops.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: What's up with the cloud bill?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Up {MONEY}, and it's mostly an idle test cluster nobody turned off.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {MONEY}, really?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Classic.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: How's the certificate renewal looking?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The main certificate expires on {DATE_ABS}, and the auto-renewal failed last night.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {DATE_ABS}, got it.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: That's not great.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: No, but we have some time.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The auto-renewal for our main certificate failed, and it expires on {DATE_ABS}.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {DATE_ABS}, got it.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Hmm.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: There's still a bit of time.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I've been looking at the slow dashboard.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: One query takes eight seconds because it's missing an index.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Easy fix then?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Should be.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Any idea why the dashboard is so slow?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: A single query without an index, it takes eight seconds on its own.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Oh, that's an easy one.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Is the new hire's laptop set up?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Mostly.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: They still can't access the code repository because their account isn't approved.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Ugh.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The new hire is stuck, because their repository account hasn't been approved.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Seriously?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Everything else on the laptop is ready.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: About the open-source library we use for PDFs.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The maintainer announced it won't get updates after this year.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: That's annoying.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We have time, but not forever.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: What's the news on the PDF library?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Its maintainer is stopping updates at the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Annoying.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Not urgent, but it's coming.
